'''Dolanaar''' was a [[Night elf|night elven]] village located in the central-eastern part of [[Teldrassil]]. Found just southwest of [[Shadowglen]], its central location made it involved in much of Teldrassil's regional affairs and the first major town usually encountered by aspiring night elf [[adventurer]]s after leaving [[Shadowglen]]. [[Class trainer]]s for all night elven classes, as well as [[profession]] training, were also available here.
